11 labelled questions scored, 4 "no answer" questions excluded (they are measured by
the refusal rate, not by recall). Retrieval depth 20, HNSW `ef_search=80`,
RRF `k=60`. Latency is end to end per question, on CPU.

**Recall is capped by the labels**, because several questions have more relevant offers than there
are slots: recall@1 ≤ 0.256 · recall@5 ≤ 0.696 · recall@10 ≤ 0.970 · recall@20 ≤ 1.000. The `recall_of_ceiling@k` figures in `retrieval.json` give the share of the
achievable recall that was actually achieved.
